environment: Windows; Minecraft Java 26.3; Space Engineers 1.210.014; dedicated offline cloned worlds

catalog.note: Other imported Minecraft recipe families remain explicitly unsupported by this workshop. No per-item recipe list was added.

integrationChecks.name: SE to Minecraft crafting
integrationChecks.evidence: 3 native SE iron ingots consumed; 1 native MC bucket added

integrationChecks.name: Cold restart during cross-engine craft
integrationChecks.evidence: 21 MC iron consumed for 1 SE steel plate; both engines saved and exited at grant stage; full restart produced exactly 1 plate; later full restart still retained exactly 1 plate

integrationChecks.name: Durable receipt replay after restart
integrationChecks.evidence: Replaying the earlier 21-iron creative grant returned committed; current iron quantity remained 18, not 39

integrationChecks.name: Mixed ingredients in SE output
integrationChecks.evidence: Final build consumed 18 MC iron and 3 SE iron together for 1 new native SE steel plate; total plates became 2

integrationChecks.name: Mouse-driven in-game crafting
integrationChecks.evidence: Searched native workshop, selected Oak Planks and clicked craft once; logs 62 to 61, planks 8 to 12

integrationChecks.name: Previously unlisted block
integrationChecks.evidence: Cherry Planks discovered at dynamic index 267; placement count 12 to 11 and native block created; breaking restored count 12 and removed only the temporary block

integrationChecks.name: Crafting table handoff
integrationChecks.evidence: Shared interaction handler opened native MC crafting table, received native close acknowledgement and opened unified crafting screen; MC menu confirmed closed

integrationChecks.name: Actual native SE tool
integrationChecks.evidence: Selecting owned Hand Drill equipped MyHandDrill and disabled MC editing; selecting MC planks restored MC editing and unequipped the SE tool

integrationChecks.name: Unowned selection
integrationChecks.evidence: Selecting absent diamond block left both native held Cherry Planks and HUD unchanged; inventory hash unchanged

integrationChecks.name: Exact component-bearing stack selection
integrationChecks.evidence: Two diamond axes with different names and damage values 17 and 3 were selected through separate stack references; native held hash matched each requested stack

integrationChecks.name: Stale exact stack selection
integrationChecks.evidence: Invalid stack hash rejected before inventory mutation

integrationChecks.name: Visual interface
integrationChecks.evidence: Native SE inventory and crafting screens visually inspected; MC and SE icons/counts shown together; native textbox filtering and mouse crafting exercised

performance.note: Observed samples on this machine, not a benchmark guarantee. Initial catalog construction has a higher one-time cost.

verificationLimits: Automation-injected world hotkeys were not accepted by the native game, including its own Escape. Textbox key events and mouse controls worked. I/G/Shift+I bindings were reviewed in code; physical keyboard presses were not independently observed.
Cold recovery used explicit native saves and graceful process exits at a deliberately paused transaction stage. This is not a power-loss or disk-corruption test.
Capacity and component conservation were tested with native item codecs and inventory merge routines; no full live inventory reset or destructive capacity fixture was used.
Shared storage networks, industrial machine queues, energy, full survival balance and arbitrary special item behaviors are outside this release.
